description: Oracle data plus Lightning Network capacity/channels and daily mining revenue — use this for ecosystem-level stats. Price: 100 sats (Lightning) or $0.10 USDC on Base (x402). Sample (illustrative, not live): {"status":"success","endpoint":"btc_pro","data":{"market":{"price_usd":97500.0,"change_24h_percent":1.23},"on_chain":{"hash_rate_eh":750.0,"block_height":920000},"lightning":{"capacity_btc":5200.0,"channel_count":12000,"node_count":13000},"mining":{"daily_revenue_btc":450.0,"daily_revenue_usd":43875000.0}},"metadata":{"cost_sats":100}} Pay: Call it, get HTTP 402 (or MCP payment_required) with a Lightning invoice and macaroon, pay the invoice, then retry with `Authorization: L402 <macaroon>:<preimage>`. Or pay in USDC on Base via x402: sign the 402's x402 requirement (PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, or `accepts` in the JSON body) and retry with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2) or X-PAYMENT (v1) header; only a 200 is settled.

l402_credential.description: Optional L402 credential '<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' (or 'L402 <macaroon>:<preimage>') from a paid invoice or an active subscription. Omit it to receive the Lightning invoice and macaroon.

x402_payment.description: Optional x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload (v2, or v1 X-PAYMENT format) signed for accepts[0] of this tool's payment_required result. Alternative to params._meta['x402/payment']. Omit both to receive the payment requirements.
